description: If Earth Could Sing is an interactive Earth data jukebox. Visitors explore a 3D globe, choose a destination, and hear NASA temperature, precipitation, and wind data translated into music. A global exhibit also turns NASA temperature maps from 1881 to 2023 into sound. Visitors can inspect how each sound relates to the data and compare places or time periods. The project offers another way to explore climate patterns through listening alongside maps and numbers. Solo team project.
